question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
WITH customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           MIN(payment_date) as initial_purchase_date,
           SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING SUM(amount) > 0
),
customer_7day AS (
    SELECT cl.customer_id,
           cl.initial_purchase_date,
           cl.total_ltv,
           SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date - cl.initial_purchase_date <= INTERVAL '7 days' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_7day
    FROM customer_ltv cl
    JOIN payment p ON cl.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY cl.customer_id, cl.initial_purchase_date, cl.total_ltv
),
customer_30day AS (
    SELECT cl.customer_id,
           cl.initial_purchase_date,
           cl.total_ltv,
           SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date - cl.initial_purchase_date <= INTERVAL '30 days' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_30day
    FROM customer_ltv cl
    JOIN payment p ON cl.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY cl.customer_id, cl.initial_purchase_date, cl.total_ltv
)
SELECT 
    AVG(cltv.total_ltv) as avg_total_ltv,
    AVG(CASE WHEN cltv.total_ltv > 0 THEN (cltv_7d.ltv_7day * 1.0 / cltv.total_ltv) * 100 ELSE NULL END) as avg_pct_7day,
    AVG(CASE WHEN cltv.total_ltv > 0 THEN (cltv_30d.ltv_30day * 1.0 / cltv.total_ltv) * 100 ELSE NULL END) as avg_pct_30day
FROM customer_ltv cltv
JOIN customer_7day cltv_7d ON cltv.customer_id = cltv_7d.customer_id
JOIN customer_30day cltv_30d ON cltv.customer_id = cltv_30d.customer_id
